plans.title: Bible in One Year
plans.description: Read through the entire Bible from Genesis to Revelation in 365 days.

plans.title: New Testament in 90 Days
plans.description: Journey through the New Testament in just 90 days.

plans.title: Psalms in 30 Days
plans.description: Read all 150 Psalms in one month of daily readings.

plans.title: The Gospels in 60 Days
plans.description: Walk through Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John in two months.

plans.title: Daily Proverbs Chapter
plans.description: Read the Proverbs chapter that matches today’s day of the month, repeating every month.

plans.title: Kathisma
plans.description: Read the appointed morning and evening kathismata for each weekday, repeating every week.

plans.title: Common Prayer Psalter
plans.description: Pray all 150 Psalms each month, morning and evening, as appointed in the Book of Common Prayer.

plans.title: The Week of Christ
plans.description: Each day of the week remembers part of Jesus’ story: the Resurrection on Sunday, the betrayal on Wednesday, the Cross on Friday.

plans.title: The Lord’s Prayer Week
plans.description: Pray the Lord’s Prayer every day, then read a passage that opens up one of its lines.

plans.title: The Gospels Every Month
plans.description: Read Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John by the day of the month, starting again each month.

plans.title: Whole Bible: Book by Book
plans.description: Read all 66 books in 365 days, beginning with Genesis, Job, and Exodus.

plans.title: Epistles in 30 Days
plans.description: Read the letters of Paul, Peter, James, and John in one month.

plans.title: Sermon on the Mount
plans.description: A week-long deep dive into Jesus' most famous teaching in Matthew 5-7.

plans.title: Full Bible in 30 Days
plans.description: Read the entire Bible in one month — about 40 chapters per day. The ultimate Scripture sprint.

plans.title: Full Bible in 90 Days
plans.description: Cover all 1,189 chapters of the Bible in 90 days, about 13 chapters per day.

plans.title: New Testament in 30 Days
plans.description: Read the full New Testament in a month — about 9 chapters per day.

plans.title: Gospels in 30 Days
plans.description: A comfortable month-long journey through all four Gospels, about 3 chapters per day.

plans.title: Acts in 28 Days
plans.description: One chapter of Acts per day — follow the early church from Jerusalem to Rome.

plans.title: Foundations of the Gospel
plans.description: Trace the story of salvation from creation to new creation over 14 days.

plans.title: Prayer & Intimacy with God
plans.description: A 7-day journey into prayer, worship, and close communion with the Lord.

plans.title: Identity in Christ
plans.description: Read Scripture that roots your identity, security, and calling in Jesus.

plans.title: The Kingdom of God
plans.description: Explore Jesus' kingdom teaching across the Gospels and the early church.

plans.title: Spiritual Warfare
plans.description: Learn how God equips His people to stand firm against spiritual opposition.

plans.title: Holiness & Sanctification
plans.description: Pursue a life set apart through passages on holiness, obedience, and growth.

plans.title: The Great Commission & Mission
plans.description: Follow God’s mission from the promises to Abraham to the ends of the earth.

plans.title: Faith & Obedience
plans.description: Strengthen trust and obedience through stories and teachings of faithful response.

plans.title: Hearing God’s Voice
plans.description: Listen for God through the prophets, the psalms, Jesus, and the early church.

plans.title: Loss
plans.description: Seven days for grieving, from Job and Ruth to the promise that every tear will be wiped away.

plans.title: Stress
plans.description: Seven days for when it is all too much: daily provision, shared burdens, and real rest.

plans.title: Fear
plans.description: Seven days with people who faced giants, fire, and the sea, and found God beside them.

plans.title: Peace
plans.description: Seven days on the peace Jesus gives: peace with God, peace with others, and quiet trust.

plans.title: Depression
plans.description: Seven days of honest psalms and prophets for dark seasons, and the God who meets you there.

plans.title: Hope
plans.description: Seven days of promises kept, from Abraham and Joseph to dry bones that live again.

plans.title: Healing
plans.description: Seven days with the God who heals, from Naaman and Hezekiah to the touch of Jesus.

plans.title: Anger
plans.description: Seven days of stories about anger, from Cain to Jonah, and the mercy that answers it.

plans.title: Anxiety
plans.description: Seven days of learning to trust: pour out your heart, and let God keep you.

plans.title: Love
plans.description: Seven days on the love of God that never lets go, and how it teaches us to love.

plans.title: Patience
plans.description: Seven days of waiting on God with Abraham, Noah, David, and Habakkuk.

plans.title: Doubt
plans.description: Seven days with people who questioned God, from Moses to Thomas, and found Him faithful.

plans.title: Pride
plans.description: Seven days on humility: proud kings brought low, and the servant King who washed feet.

plans.title: Temptation
plans.description: Seven days on standing firm, with Jesus in the wilderness, Joseph who ran, and David who fell.

plans.title: Family
plans.description: Seven days on families in Scripture, torn apart and restored, and the family of God.

plans.title: Advent
plans.description: From the first Sunday of Advent to Christmas Eve: a week each of hope, peace, joy, and love, from the prophets’ promises to the angel’s visit to Mary.

plans.title: The Twelve Days of Christmas
plans.description: From Christmas Day to 5 January: the birth of Jesus, the Word made flesh, and the wise men who followed the star.
